input.thread_rule: the adapter is sampled synchronously by one producer thread and exposes no audio objects
input.material_box_rule: every appended AABB must be finite, positive-volume and contained inside the sampled unit block cell
input.generation_rule: generation before and after the complete scan must match

output.lists: immutable material boxes and coplanar-compacted exposed patches
output.coverage: the exact inclusive sampled block-cell bounds
output.incomplete_policy: publish empty box and patch lists; no explicit early paths
output.halo: patch owners are restricted to sampled bounds contracted by the configured halo

fixtures: material box escapes sampled cell and is rejected
